items.rationale: Sections 2.4.4 and 7.1.9 cover like-for-like renewal of the internal frost-fractured fitting. One valve is estimated at €52 gross.
Sections 2.4.4 and 7.1.9 cover the hose where renewal is necessary with the fractured valve. The comparable gross threshold is €27 for one hose.
Necessary fitting-repair labour is covered under 7.1.7(f) and 7.1.9. Three hours at about €100 gross per hour give a calibrated line total of €299.

Sections 7.1.7(e) and 7.1.9 cover consumables actually used on the repair, but this generic line does not identify them and may include excluded shop supplies under 3.6(c). Allow about €18 if substantiated.
Sections 2.4.4 and 7.1.11 cover one plumbing attendance for the insured work. The closest same-wording references support about €40 gross.
Sections 2.4.6 and 5.2.2 expressly cover imaging equipment used to locate the internal escape. The estimated use charge is €17.60 gross, and the €2,500 leak-location cap does not bind.

items.description: Facade damage from internal water escape
items.rationale: Section 2.4.3 covers the render damaged when escaped water froze; optional external-frost cover is not needed. Under 7.1.12, allow about €150 gross only if this line prices distinct patch repair rather than duplicating the itemised work.
Sections 2.4.3 and 7.1.7(a) cover removal of plaster loosened by the escaped water. Allow about €85 gross for stripping the affected patch only.
Sections 2.4.3 and 7.1.7(c)–(d) cover like-for-like base plaster on the affected patch. The comparable gross line threshold is €38.
Sections 7.1.12 and 9.6 require the work to be identified and allocated to the covered repair. If itemised as a distinct minor repair task, allow about €45 gross.
Sections 2.4.3 and 7.1.7(c) cover forming the substrate on the damaged patch, without duplicating base plaster work. The comparable gross line threshold is €31.
Sections 7.1.5 and 7.1.7(d) cover only the damaged area and the coats required by the pre-loss finish system. The comparable gross allowance is €59 for the line, not €59 per coat.
Sections 2.4.3 and 7.1.7(c) cover drying the saturated wall before reinstatement. The comparable drying line is estimated at €254 gross.
Sections 7.1.7(c)–(d) cover primer needed to restore the finish on the affected patch. The comparable gross line threshold is €117.
Sections 7.1.5 and 7.1.7(f) cover labour on the patch damaged by the internal escape, not on unaffected facade areas. Five hours at about €55 gross per hour give a calibrated line total of €277.

Sections 3.6(b) and 7.1.12 exclude a standalone surcharge, and this line identifies no covered work. A conditional allowance of €40 gross applies only if it is shown to price distinct covered work or necessary access under 7.1.8.
